* **
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Lalit Batra
 ----

Present: Mr. B.D.Sharma, Advocate for the petitioners.
 Ms. Ruchika Sabherwal, Deputy Advocate General, Punjab.

Mr. Ashok Kumar Khanna, Advocate
 for respondent No.2 - complainant.
Lalit Batra, J.(Oral)

This petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been moved by the petitioners namely Kunal Sharma and Sameer Marwaha for grant of pre- arrest bail in case FIR No.119 dated 25.09.2021 under Sections 419 and 420 IPC and Section 82 of Registration Act, 1908, registered at Police Station Navi Baradari, District Police Commissionerate Jalandhar.
Mr. Ashok Kumar Khanna, Advocate has filed Power of Attorney on behalf of respondent No.2 - complainant.
He submits that in terms of compromise arrived at between the parties, matter has been amicably settled.

Learned State counsel on instructions from Assistant Sub Inspector Balkaran Singh submits that in compliance of order dated 20.05.2022, both the petitioners have already joined investigation and are not required for further investigation or any kind of custodial interrogation.

She 1 of 2 further submits that after completion of investigation, final report as envisaged under Section 173 Cr.P.C.
(Challan) has already been presented in the Court.
